description: Down-migration registry. Maps up-migrations to their reverse. Used by migration-runner --down to pick the right script. Not every up has a down — gold-standard append-only invariants (audit chain, event store) require explicit dev/staging-only down-flags. See LITFIN-parity item 5.
scope: 10 highest-blast-radius migrations from 0252..0273, the 0317/0318 Borjie-parity RLS+idempotency ports, and the 0319..0323 parity-final back-port (portal-genui tabs/records/self-healing + connector-OAuth credentials/nonces). Older migrations get down scripts in follow-up passes.

mappings.notes: Undo journal is a transient 5-min reverse buffer; the immutable AI audit chain holds the durable record.

mappings.notes: Pending approvals are short-lived (24h TTL); cancellation forces operators to re-propose. Production rollback must be coordinated with the platform-admin council.

mappings.notes: Per-owner learned communication style; rebuildable from subsequent chat turns (the feedback loop re-converges from a neutral default). Dropping it costs the owner their personalised voice until it re-learns.

mappings.notes: Generated courses are rebuildable from the same domain + scenario inputs, but learner quiz progress (course_lessons quiz_score/status/completed_at) is lost. Production rollback must be coordinated by #ops.

mappings.reverses: ADD COLUMN cases.photos jsonb DEFAULT '[]'

mappings.reverses: CREATE TABLE durable_scheduled_wakes + durable_armed_monitors + unique/scan indexes + RLS policies (tenant_isolation + service_role_bypass) + REVOKE anon
mappings.notes: Drops the crash-resilient backing store for the orchestrator's schedule_wake / monitor Decisions. Any armed-but-not-yet-fired wakes/monitors are lost; the supervisor degrades to the storeless in-process fallback (arms lost on restart again). No money/audit data here.

mappings.reverses: ENABLE/FORCE RLS + tenant_isolation_select/modify + service_role_bypass policies on person_links + REVOKE anon; non-partial unique index disbursements_tenant_idempotency_uq (tenant_id, idempotency_key)
mappings.notes: No table/row data is destroyed — person_links rows survive. The down only removes the RLS posture (re-opening the cross-tenant identity-linkage leak) and the redundant atomic-claim arbiter index; the 0174 partial idempotency index is left intact. MUST NOT run in production: disabling RLS re-exposes person→tenant→user PII linkage across tenants.

mappings.reverses: ENABLE/FORCE RLS + tenant_isolation_<tbl> + <tbl>_service_role_bypass policies on org_memberships, invite_codes (platform_tenant_id=GUC), geo_label_types, geo_nodes, geo_assignments (organization_id->organizations.tenant_id FK-subquery) + REVOKE anon
mappings.notes: Borjie-parity port of 0336. No table/row data destroyed — rows survive. The down only removes the RLS posture (re-opening the cross-tenant leak on org_memberships/invite_codes/geo_* identity+geo hierarchy). MUST NOT run in production: disabling RLS re-exposes per-org membership, invite tokens, and geo hierarchy across tenants.

mappings.reverses: CREATE TABLE journal_idempotency + journal_idempotency_journal_idx + FORCE RLS tenant_isolation policy + REVOKE anon
mappings.notes: Borjie-parity port of 0162. Dropping the dedupe rows re-opens double-post risk on LedgerService.postJournalEntry. MUST NOT run in production: replay-defense for the money path.

mappings.reverses: CREATE TABLE portal_tabs + portal_tabs_tenant_user_idx + portal_tabs_parent_idx + portal_tabs_tenant_tab_key_uq (unique) + FORCE RLS portal_tabs_tenant_isolation (app.current_tenant_id GUC) + REVOKE anon
mappings.notes: Portal-GenUI back-port (#10/#11). The MD-authored dynamic-tabs document store. Tenant-scoped, FORCE RLS. No money/licence/ledger rows live here — a tab is a UI/forms document only. MUST NOT run in production: discards every MD-authored PortalTab document and re-opens cross-tenant exposure of the tab store.

mappings.reverses: CREATE TABLE portal_tab_records + portal_tab_records_tenant_tab_idx + FORCE RLS tenant_isolation_portal_tab_records + portal_tab_records_service_role_bypass + REVOKE anon
mappings.notes: Portal-GenUI back-port (K1a). The generic schema-on-read record store that makes a generated tab ACT — every record from every generated tab lands here as tenant-scoped JSONB payload. Tenant-isolated, FORCE RLS. Dropping reverts generated tabs to render-only (portal_tabs documents untouched). No money/ledger. MUST NOT run in production: discards every record submitted into a generated tab.

mappings.reverses: CREATE TABLE self_healing_proposals + self_healing_proposals_dedupe_key (unique) + self_healing_proposals_status_seen_idx + FORCE RLS self_healing_proposals_service_role_bypass (service-role-only; a tenant request sees ZERO rows) + REVOKE anon
mappings.notes: Portal-GenUI back-port (Borjie 0349). PLATFORM-INTERNAL self-healing console queue for the MAPE-K loop — NOT tenant-isolated (tenant_id is nullable TRIAGE context, never an access boundary). Service-role-only bypass: an owner can never read or approve the platform healing of its own wiring. Dropping discards the internal-admin repair-proposal queue.

mappings.reverses: CREATE TABLE connector_credentials + idx_connector_creds_tenant_kind + idx_connector_creds_expiry + FORCE RLS tenant_isolation_connector_credentials + connector_credentials_service_role_bypass + REVOKE anon
mappings.notes: Connector-OAuth completion (#12, Borjie 0343). Per-tenant per-account OAuth credential store; access/refresh token columns are AES-GCM ciphertext sealed with a tenant-bound DEK (the database NEVER sees plaintext). Tenant-isolated, FORCE RLS. Dropping forces every connector to be reconnected. MUST NOT run in production: discards every tenant's connector OAuth state.

mappings.reverses: CREATE TABLE oauth_state_nonces + oauth_state_nonces_created_idx + FORCE RLS oauth_state_nonces_tenant_isolation + oauth_state_nonces_service_role_bypass + REVOKE anon
mappings.notes: Connector-OAuth completion (#12). DURABLE single-use consumption of the connector-OAuth `state` nonce — multi-replica replay protection (a per-process Set cannot defend across replicas). Nonces are opaque random values: no PII, no token material, so the data loss is benign. Dropping re-opens cross-replica OAuth state replay until restored.

mappings.reverses: DROP partial UNIQUE index ledger_entries_payment_intent_rent_debit_uniq (tenant_id, payment_intent_id) WHERE payment_intent_id IS NOT NULL AND type='RENT_PAYMENT' AND direction='DEBIT'
mappings.notes: Wave-B Stripe-webhook idempotency DB backstop: one rent-payment cash DEBIT leg per (tenant_id, payment_intent_id). Index-only (no table/column drop) so the down is non-destructive and prod-safe. The index build fails LOUD on a populated table that already holds duplicate rent cash legs — reconcile the double-credit before applying.

mappings.reverses: ADD COLUMN kernel_cot_reservoir.user_id (TEXT) + consolidated_at (TIMESTAMPTZ) + partial index idx_kernel_cot_unconsolidated
mappings.notes: Wave-B memory-consolidation cursor columns the consolidation-worker codes against (was a schema-drift silent no-op — every hourly tick errored and was swallowed as []). Down drops the per-row consolidated_at cursor; re-applying 0325 re-consolidates already-consolidated turns. Additive ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS, so forward-apply is prod-safe.

mappings.reverses: CREATE TABLE field_captures + field_captures_tenant_type_idx + field_captures_tenant_property_idx + field_captures_tenant_client_uq (unique) + FORCE RLS tenant_isolation_select/modify + service_role_bypass + REVOKE anon

Dropping discards persisted attendance/incident/shift-report captures; the post-fix staff app RETAINS+retries on the resulting 5xx so an accidental down does not silently destroy in-flight field data.

mappings.reverses: CREATE TABLE owner_settings + UNIQUE(tenant_id,user_id) + idx_owner_settings_tenant_user + FORCE RLS tenant_isolation + service_role_bypass + REVOKE anon

Dropping discards saved owner preferences; Settings falls back to route defaults (en/USD/Africa/Dar_es_Salaam).

mappings.reverses: CREATE TABLE co_owner_invites + uniq_co_owner_invites_token + idx_co_owner_invites_tenant_status + FORCE RLS tenant_isolation + service_role_bypass + REVOKE anon
mappings.notes: Deferred-batch pending owner-portal team invitations (SettingsPage co-owner invite/revoke/resend — was a client-only illusion, now real via notification_dispatch_log). Accepted co-owners are real users rows (untouched). Dropping discards pending invites; owners re-invite.

mappings.reverses: CREATE POLICY service_role_bypass on kernel_cot_reservoir + briefing_subscriptions (closes the 0179 bypass gap for two later-created cross-tenant system-job tables)
mappings.notes: R2-supplement RLS-darkness fix: the consolidation-worker (CoT->semantic) and executive-brief cron scan these FORCE-RLS tables cross-tenant; without a service_role_bypass policy they matched ZERO rows under the non-BYPASS prod role (born-dark — no CoT consolidation, no briefs). Additive permissive FOR ALL policy gated solely on app.is_service_role; tenant-scoped access is unchanged. Dropping re-darkens both workers but loses no data.
